analysis_set.span: Intention-to-treat (ITT) analysis was performed on the available participants.

follow_up.span: The data on outcomes were collected using study diaries during antibiotic treatment and for 7 additional days.

entry_age.span: Eligibility criteria included age from 3 months to 18 years, recruitment within 24 hours following initiation of broad-spectrum oral or intravenous antibiotic therapy, and signed informed consent.

notes: The served AAD RR 0.81 (95% CI, 0.49-1.33) is reported in Table 2, titled Main Results of the Available Case Analysis. The source calls this ITT, but includes 313 of 350 randomized participants, so it is an available-case analysis rather than all randomized participants. The lower entry-age limit was amended from 6 to 3 months. The Participants eligibility and exclusion criteria do not place the population outside the question's patients receiving antibiotics.
